assertion.statement: In v2.0.0, cmd/crossplane/core/core.go removed the error-return naming --enable-environment-configs ("Crossplane no longer supports loading and patching EnvironmentConfigs natively. Please use function-environment-configs instead. The --enable-environment-configs flag will be removed in a future release."), deleting the v1.20.1 handling of that flag.

proposal.undeterminedReason: consequence: The evidence only shows the v1.20.1 error-return line being deleted; it does not state what v2.0.0 does when --enable-environment-configs is still passed (e.g. whether the flag is no longer registered so the Crossplane pod would fail to start, or whether the check was only moved/reworded), so no consequence kind can be asserted.
